Case study

From Concept to Execution

The Challenge

Light Choice Meat Products needed a brand people would trust at first glance — something that looked established, clean and professional in a competitive local market.

Our Approach

We built a mark around a simple, confident cow-head symbol paired with sturdy typography, then extended it consistently across every material the business actually uses day to day.

The Solution

A complete identity system — logo, price-list banners, promotional print ads and branded staff polos — giving the business one consistent look from the counter to the street.
